title: 🔥 DO ONLY PRIESTS HAVE AUTHORITY TO PREACH? AM I A CULT LEADER? LET’S SEE WHAT THE BIBLE SAYS! 🔥
paragraphs:
🔥 DO ONLY PRIESTS HAVE AUTHORITY TO PREACH? AM I A CULT LEADER? LET’S SEE WHAT THE BIBLE SAYS! 🔥
📖 Matthew 28:19-20 – "Go therefore and make disciples of all nations, baptizing them in the name of the Father and of the Son and of the Holy Spirit, teaching them to observe all that I have commanded you. And behold, I am with you always, to the end of the age."

❓ QUESTION FROM A READER:
"Brother John, some people say that only priests have the authority to preach the Word of God. They call you a ‘cult leader’ because you’re not a priest. Do you really have the authority to teach and preach? What does the Bible say about this?"
🔥 GREAT QUESTION! This is a common belief in many religious circles—that only ordained priests or pastors can teach God’s Word. But is this tradition or biblical truth?
🚨 Let’s go straight to Scripture and see what GOD says about who has the authority to preach His Word!

🔥 1. DOES ONLY A PRIEST HAVE THE AUTHORITY TO PREACH?
📖 Acts 8:4 – "Those who had been scattered preached the word wherever they went."
🔥 The early church was not built by priests—it was built by believers!

✔️ Jesus NEVER said only priests could preach.
✔️ The Bible NEVER says only pastors have authority to teach.
✔️ God commands ALL believers to share the gospel.

💡 REAL-LIFE EXAMPLE:
If only "ordained" priests could preach, then why did Jesus choose Fishermen, tax collectors, and ordinary men to be His disciples?
👉 Because the authority to preach comes from GOD—not man!
🚨 EVERY CHRISTIAN HAS A DUTY TO SHARE GOD’S WORD!

🔥 2. WHO GAVE ME AUTHORITY TO PREACH? JESUS CHRIST HIMSELF!
📖 Matthew 28:18-20 – "Then Jesus came to them and said, ‘ALL AUTHORITY in heaven and on earth has been given to Me. Therefore GO and make disciples of all nations… teaching them to obey everything I have commanded you.’"
🚨 Jesus gave the command to PREACH to EVERY believer, NOT just priests!

🔥 WHO DID JESUS GIVE AUTHORITY TO?
✔️ To the apostles (ordinary men).
✔️ To the early Christians (non-priests).
✔️ To ALL disciples—including YOU and ME!
📖 Mark 16:15 – "Go into all the world and preach the gospel to all creation."

💡 REAL-LIFE EXAMPLE:
If a king sends his messenger with a decree, does the messenger need approval from anyone else?
👉 No! Because the king’s authority is enough!
🔥 MY AUTHORITY COMES FROM JESUS, NOT FROM RELIGION!

🔥 3. AM I A CULT LEADER FOR PREACHING THE BIBLE?
📖 Acts 5:29 – "Peter and the other apostles replied: ‘We must obey God rather than human beings!’"
🚨 What defines a cult? A cult is a group that teaches UNBIBLICAL doctrine.

🔥 BUT EVERYTHING I PREACH IS FROM SCRIPTURE!
✔️ I do NOT preach personal opinions—I preach the Bible.
✔️ I do NOT twist God’s Word—I declare it as written.
✔️ I do NOT create false doctrines—I expose deception.

💡 REAL-LIFE EXAMPLE:
If preaching straight from the Bible makes me a "cult leader," then what does that make Jesus and the apostles?
👉 The world hated Jesus for preaching the truth—and they will hate His followers too!
📖 John 15:18 – "If the world hates you, keep in mind that it hated Me first."
🔥 THEY CALL ME A CULT LEADER BECAUSE THEY CAN’T HANDLE THE TRUTH!

🔥 4. DID GOD EVER USE NON-PRIESTS TO PREACH HIS WORD?
📖 1 Corinthians 1:27 – "But God chose the foolish things of the world to shame the wise; God chose the weak things of the world to shame the strong."
🔥 YES! THROUGHOUT HISTORY, GOD HAS USED ORDINARY MEN!

✔️ Moses was not a priest—he was a shepherd!
✔️ David was not a priest—he was a young boy!
✔️ Paul was not a priest—he was a former persecutor of Christians!
📖 Acts 9:15 – "But the Lord said to Ananias, ‘Go! This man is My chosen instrument to proclaim My name to the Gentiles and their kings and to the people of Israel.’"

💡 REAL-LIFE EXAMPLE:
If God calls a person to share His Word, who can stop Him?
👉 Man-made religious systems do NOT decide who God can use!
🔥 IF GOD CALLS YOU, NO MAN CAN SILENCE YOU!

🔥 5. WHAT SHOULD WE DO AS BELIEVERS?
📖 2 Timothy 4:2 – "Preach the word; be prepared in season and out of season; correct, rebuke and encourage—with great patience and careful instruction."

🚨 THE BIBLE COMMANDS US TO:
✔️ Preach the gospel to all nations. (Matthew 28:19)
✔️ Defend the faith boldly. (Jude 1:3)
✔️ Expose false teachings. (Ephesians 5:11)
🔥 AND THAT IS EXACTLY WHAT I AM DOING!

💡 REAL-LIFE EXAMPLE:
If a house is on fire, should you wait for a "certified firefighter" to arrive, or warn the people inside?
👉 Millions are headed to hell—I will not stay silent!
🚨 I WILL PREACH THE TRUTH WHETHER RELIGION ACCEPTS IT OR NOT!

🔥 FINAL VERDICT: WHO HAS AUTHORITY TO PREACH?
📖 Galatians 1:10 – "Am I now trying to win the approval of human beings, or of God? Or am I trying to please people? If I were still trying to please people, I would not be a servant of Christ."

🚨 THE BIBLE SAYS:
❌ You don’t need to be a priest to preach.
❌ You don’t need approval from men to share the gospel.
❌ You don’t need permission from religion to obey God!
🔥 MY AUTHORITY COMES FROM JESUS CHRIST!

👉 WHAT WILL YOU CHOOSE?
✔️ Stay silent because of religious fear?
❌ Or boldly declare God’s truth to a lost world?
🚨 PREACH THE WORD—THE TIME IS SHORT!

🙏 POWERFUL PRAYER FOR BOLDNESS IN PREACHING
"Lord Jesus, I surrender to Your calling. Give me boldness to speak Your Word, no matter what people say. I do not seek man’s approval—I seek to honor You! Strengthen me to stand firm in truth. In Jesus’ name, AMEN!"
